name: Rage
summary: Enter Rage for combat benefits, including resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage and additional damage with Strength-based weapon attacks or Unarmed Strikes. Rage prevents Concentration and spellcasting. Check the source for uses, duration, continuation, and level-dependent benefits.

name: Reckless Attack
summary: When making your first attack roll on your turn, you can gain Advantage on Strength-based attack rolls until the start of your next turn. Attack rolls against you also have Advantage during that time.

name: Brutal Strike
summary: When using Reckless Attack, forgo Advantage on one eligible Strength-based attack roll to gain additional damage and a Brutal Strike effect on a hit. Check the source for restrictions, options, and higher-level improvements.

name: Bardic Inspiration
summary: Give a Bardic Inspiration die to another creature within 60 feet that can see or hear you. It can use the die after failing a D20 Test. Check the source for die size, duration, uses, and recovery.

name: Countercharm
summary: When you or a creature within 30 feet fails a saving throw against an effect that applies Charmed or Frightened, use a Reaction to allow that creature to reroll the save with Advantage.

name: Channel Divinity
summary: Channel divine energy through Divine Spark or Turn Undead. These are distinct Magic-action options with their own targeting and effects. Check the source for uses, recovery, and scaling; no spell slot or resource is spent by adding this reference.

name: Sear Undead
summary: When using Turn Undead, you can deal Radiant damage to each Undead that fails its saving throw. Check the source for damage and interaction with Turn Undead.

name: Wild Shape
summary: Transform into an eligible Beast form you have seen. Check the source for known forms, challenge-rating and movement restrictions, duration, uses, statistics, and retained capabilities. Adding this reference does not replace your Character Record.

name: Elemental Fury
summary: Choose Potent Spellcasting or Primal Strike. The former benefits Druid cantrip damage; the latter adds elemental damage on a qualifying hit once on each of your turns. Check the source for exact choices and scaling.

name: Second Wind
summary: Regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Fighter level. You start with two uses, regain one expended use after a Short Rest, and all uses after a Long Rest. Higher Fighter levels grant more uses.

name: Weapon Mastery
summary: Choose three kinds of Simple or Martial weapons whose mastery properties you can use. A Long Rest lets you change one choice. Higher Fighter levels grant more choices. A weapon’s mastery property is not automatically available just because you have added its attack.

name: Action Surge
summary: On your turn, take one additional action, except the Magic action. Recover its use after a Short or Long Rest. At Fighter level 17, you have two uses before resting, but can use it only once on a turn.

name: Extra Attack
summary: Attack twice instead of once when taking the Attack action on your turn. Fighter level 11 increases this to three attacks, and level 20 to four. This is a rule for the Attack action, not an extra damage bonus.

name: Tactical Shift
summary: When activating Second Wind with a Bonus Action, move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

name: Indomitable
summary: Reroll a failed saving throw with a bonus equal to your Fighter level, and use the new roll. Recover after a Long Rest. You gain a second use at Fighter level 13 and a third at level 17.

name: Tactical Master
summary: When attacking with a weapon whose mastery property you can use, replace that property with Push, Sap, or Slow for that attack.

name: Studied Attacks
summary: After an attack roll against a creature misses, gain Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

name: Martial Arts
summary: Gain benefits while unarmed or wielding only Monk weapons, without armor or a Shield: a Bonus Unarmed Strike, Martial Arts damage dice, and Dexterous Attacks. Check the source for qualifying weapons and level-dependent dice.

name: Monk’s Focus
summary: Spend Focus Points on Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, or Step of the Wind. Check the source for the free and paid Bonus Action options, recovery, and later improvements. Adding this reference does not spend Focus Points.

name: Deflect Attacks
summary: Reduce damage when an attack roll hits you and includes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage. If reduced to zero, you can spend a Focus Point to redirect energy. Check the source for reduction, targeting, saving throw, and damage.

name: Stunning Strike
summary: Once per turn, after hitting with a Monk weapon or Unarmed Strike, spend a Focus Point to attempt a Stunning Strike. Check the source for the Constitution save, Stunned duration, and effects on a successful save.

name: Lay On Hands
summary: Touch a creature to restore Hit Points from your healing pool, or spend points to remove Poisoned without restoring HP. Check the source for pool size, recovery, and point cost.

name: Paladin’s Smite
summary: Always have Divine Smite prepared and cast it once without expending a spell slot, recovering that free use after a Long Rest. Consult Divine Smite in the Spell Catalog for the actual spell; this feature does not automatically add damage.

name: Radiant Strikes
summary: When you hit a target with an attack roll using a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike, the target takes an additional 1d8 Radiant damage.

name: Favored Enemy
summary: Always have Hunter’s Mark prepared and gain free casts without spell slots. Check the source for the number of free uses and Long Rest recovery. Consult Hunter’s Mark in the Spell Catalog for its effects.

name: Nature’s Veil
summary: Gain Invisible until the end of your next turn. Check the source for uses based on Wisdom modifier and Long Rest recovery.

name: Sneak Attack
summary: Once per turn, add extra damage to one creature hit by an attack roll using a Finesse or Ranged weapon if you have Advantage. Advantage is unnecessary if an ally is within 5 feet of the target, that ally is not Incapacitated, and you do not have Disadvantage. Damage uses the weapon’s type and scales with Rogue level; consult the Rogue table on page 62. This modifies a qualifying hit rather than making another attack.

name: Weapon Mastery
summary: Choose two kinds of weapons with which you are proficient whose mastery properties you can use. Change the choices after a Long Rest.

name: Cunning Action
summary: On your turn, take Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a Bonus Action.

name: Steady Aim
summary: Gain Advantage on your next attack roll on the current turn. You can use this only if you have not moved during the turn; afterward your Speed is 0 until the turn ends.

name: Cunning Strike
summary: When dealing Sneak Attack damage, forgo damage dice to add Poison, Trip, or Withdraw. Each costs 1d6. Saving throw DC is 8 plus Dexterity modifier plus Proficiency Bonus. Check the source for targeting, Poisoner’s Kit requirement, durations, and repeat saves.

name: Uncanny Dodge
summary: When an attacker you can see hits you with an attack roll, use a Reaction to halve that attack’s damage against you, rounding down.

name: Evasion
summary: When an effect allows a Dexterity saving throw for half damage, instead take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure. You cannot use this while Incapacitated.

name: Improved Cunning Strike
summary: Apply up to two Cunning Strike effects when dealing Sneak Attack damage, paying the die cost for each.

name: Devious Strikes
summary: Gain the Daze, Knock Out, and Obscure Cunning Strike options, with respective Sneak Attack die costs of 2d6, 6d6, and 3d6. Check the source for saves, conditions, and duration.

name: Elusive
summary: Attack rolls cannot have Advantage against you unless you are Incapacitated.

name: Stroke of Luck
summary: Turn the roll of a failed D20 Test into a 20. Recover the use after a Short or Long Rest.

name: Innate Sorcery
summary: For 1 minute, increase the save DC of your Sorcerer spells by 1 and gain Advantage on their attack rolls. Check the source for uses and Long Rest recovery.

name: Metamagic
summary: Spend Sorcery Points to modify spells with your chosen Metamagic options. Check the source for known options, costs, and combinations. Adding this reference does not change or cast a spell.

name: Magical Cunning
summary: Perform an esoteric rite for 1 minute to regain expended Pact Magic spell slots, up to half your maximum, rounded up. Recover this feature after a Long Rest.

name: Arcane Recovery
summary: After a Short Rest, recover eligible expended spell slots up to the allowed combined level. Check the source for the half-Wizard-level limit, rounding, slot restrictions, and Long Rest recovery.
